At the same time, our ongoing journey from products to high-technology, holistic solutions for end customers marks the next phase of our transformation. Disc - invested and maybe - biased.

posts.text: The massive capital expenditure program of roughly ₹4,650 crore, centered on two mega-projects: the Gopalpur Technical Ammonium Nitrate (TAN) project in Odisha and the Nitric Acid expansion complex in Dahej behoves well.
